name: Senlay
description: Verified physical context for systems that act outside — AI agents, drones, robots, and safety systems. Cross-checks weather models, live sensors, METAR, marine data, GPS/device telemetry, and terrain, and reports how much each answer should be trusted.
primary_use_cases: SmartSurf rider, board, school, and water-sports safety workflows
kitesurf, wing, surf, SUP, foil, sailing, windsurf, and downwind spot intelligence
indie outdoor AI apps and hobbyist agent builders
drone hobbyist and outdoor go/no-go decision support
source-aware local risk checks with freshness, confidence, and model-vs-reality signals
core_capabilities: marine source fusion: buoys, ships, tides, currents, hydrology, webcams, and model fallbacks where available
risk_event records for operational alert and audit workflows
SmartSurf-style rider, board, school, and outdoor safety workflows

authentication.trial: GET /api/v1/try-sense is available without an API key and is rate-limited.
authentication.production: Use Authorization: Bearer sl_live_... for /api/v1/sense, /api/v1/pwm, and /api/v1/risk-events.
authentication.registration: POST /api/v1/agent-register with ownerEmail and agentName to create an agent key.

rate_limits.try_sense: 8 requests/minute burst and 60 requests/hour per IP.
rate_limits.free_beta: 100 authenticated API calls/day, shared across all active keys on a registered beta account.

safety_disclaimer: Senlay provides context, evidence, and decision support. It is not a safety authority. Final decisions remain with operators, users, and customer applications.

positioning.commercial_product: SmartSurf is the first commercial product powered by Senlay.
positioning.engine: Senlay is the spot-level verification engine behind SmartSurf and similar outdoor AI apps.
positioning.boundary: Decision support only; not final safety authority or rescue replacement.
